<!-- What does this PR do, and why? Link the issue it resolves, if any. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `content` — new/updated template or docs content
- [ ] `refactor` — no behavior change
- [ ] `test` — test-only change
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` — tooling, dependencies, CI

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm validate:content`, and `pnpm build` all pass locally
- [ ] New behavior has a test (unit/component for logic, e2e for a user-facing flow)
- [ ] UI changes were checked in a real browser (`pnpm dev`), not just by reading the diff
- [ ] Docs updated if this changes how something is used (docs site, README, or `architecture.md`)
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] No unrelated changes bundled into this PR
